panels.title: CPU: Actual vs Predicted (+2.5 min ahead)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "actual")

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "predicted" and r.horizon == "150s")

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "actual")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "predicted" and r.horizon == "150s")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction_error")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "absolute_percent")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction_error")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "absolute_percent")
